title: Caroline+Mathew
description:
On September 30, 2023, Caroline and Matt's wedding unfolded as a beautiful tale of love and celebration. As their wedding videographer, I had the unique opportunity to capture the essence of their special day, from the early morning preparations to the sparkling end of the night.
The day began with excitement at the Lodge, where Caroline and her bridesmaids, along with their mothers, prepared for the big day. The atmosphere was filled with anticipation, joy, and laughter. Meanwhile, Matt and his groomsmen shared a camaraderie-filled morning at the Retreat.
One of the most touching moments was the first look between Caroline and Matt. The emotion in this instant was profound and heartfelt. Following this, the bridal party photos captured the elegance and happiness surrounding the couple.
The ceremony, set to the melodious tunes of a string quartet, was a beautiful blend of tradition and personal touches. Caroline's entrance to "The Wedding" from Legends Of The Fall was a highlight, leading to the heartfelt exchange of vows and rings.
The reception at Sassafras Springs Vineyard was a vibrant celebration of their union. From the first dance to the lively bouquet toss, the joy was palpable. The night concluded with a magical sparkler exit, as Caroline and Matt departed amidst a shower of light, marking the beginning of their new journey together.
Capturing this wedding was an honor. Each smile, tear, and dance reflected the deep love and joy of Caroline and Matt's special day. These memories, now immortalized in video, will be a timeless reminder of their beautiful celebration.

description:
Step into the enchanting world of Ellie and Mike's wedding held on the 16th of September, 2023. This cinematic masterpiece, crafted by our team Phaminh Cinemaphotography, captures the essence of a day filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable moments.

Set against the backdrop of the Crystal Bridges Museum of American Art in Bentonville, Arkansas, this wedding film is a testament to Ellie and Mike's love story, a day where two souls became one.

title: Savannah + Aaron
description:
On August 19th, I had the pleasure of shooting in a brand new state (LOVE IT), one I’ve been wanting to visit for some time! I added South Carolina to the list of states where I’ve filmed a wedding, which is just outside of Savannah, Georgia
Palmetto Bluff is not only one of the most beautiful places in the United States, but it is also a special place where Justin And Hailey got married in 2009. I had the pleasure and lucky enough when Savannah and Aaron contact me to be a part of their wedding ❤
Savannah and Aaron were so wonderful to work with on the day of their wedding celebration. The couple was laid back, relaxed, and just full of love for each other. It was an absolute delight being able to document all the special moments from their big day.
Savannah and Aaron said their vows with majestic flowers decoration and background behind them inside the chapel. Once the ceremony was completed, the couple had a fantastic party with their guests.
We even took some time to finish the day with sunset footage back around where the ceremony took place. It was a great way to put a cap on a fantastic wedding celebration.
The final stop of the evening was the Montage Palmetto Bluff, which hosted the reception for Savannah and Aaron. Savannah and Aaron had a lively 5 stars dinner and party with their family and friends. A good meal was had, toasts were made, dancing took place.
I want to wish Savannah and Aaron all the best in their lives together. I also want to thank them and Katherine, Clay, and their grandparents for having me again to video their wedding celebration.

description:
It's likely that the pandemic will have a lasting impact on how people envision their wedding day. Our friends and couples in 2020 have been incredibly creative and adaptable. I can't help but wonder if I would have the same level of grace if my own wedding plans were disrupted.
